chunks: Among the blessings of a woman is the smallness of her dowry, and among her misfortunes is the largeness of her dowry.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman, in the context of marriage
key_terms.بَرَكَةِ: blessing, divine good placed in a matter

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about keeping a woman's dowry small?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a modest dowry as a sign of blessing in marriage and an excessive dowry as a sign of ill omen or misfortune. It emphasizes ease and simplicity in marital arrangements and reflects an ethical preference for reducing burdens in family life.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Among the blessings of a woman is the smallness of her dowry, and among her misfortunes is the largeness of her dowry."
